summarize.response: A city's replacement of 12% of its streetlights with smart-dimming LEDs cut lighting electricity use by 34% but triggered a 9% spike in nighttime traffic incidents, which was traced to three arterials dimmed 40% below standard and resolved by restoring proper brightness within one quarter.
